name: Maine

default_limits.basis: 29-A M.R.S. §2074(1): 25 business/residential/built-up areas, 45 all other ways unless posted; 15 school zones at school times

fine.notes: Statewide Violations Bureau schedule (eff. 9/24/2025), surcharges included. 30+ over is a Class E crime: judge sets fine, up to $1,000 (17-A §1704), plus up to 6 months jail.

court_costs.notes: Included in scheduled amount (surcharges + $25 flat fees built in).

points.notes: BMV rule 29-250 ch.1 §4: <15 over 4 pts, 15-29 over 6 pts; 12 pts in 1 yr = suspension. Points for 30+ (criminal) not found.

zones.work_zone: Construction zone fines higher: $203 (1-9 over) up to $531 (25-29 over).
zones.school_zone: 15 mph at school times; fines roughly double: $203 (1-9 over) up to $531 (25-29 over).

sources.title: Maine Violations Bureau Schedule of Amounts Due
BMV rule 29-250 ch.1 §4 demerit points (Justia copy)

notes: Interstates/Turnpike are always posted (no unposted statutory freeway limit found), so motorway is null; statute's catch-all is 45. License suspension for criminal speeding not verified. Points read from Justia copy of BMV rule (current through 6/2025).
